desc: Prove necessary conditions using checkerboard coloring and row/column parity, including all impossible small cases.
Search for and formalize constructive patterns for pure-red, pure-blue, and mixed red/blue counts.
Develop a composition/extension operation that increases the number of red and/or blue pieces without breaking the cycle.
Ensure every construction uses coordinates safely within 1 to 10^9 for total size up to 2×10^5.
Semantically validate the implemented case classification and coordinate-output construction with an independent output checker over exhaustive small cases.
Make the provided sample output match byte-for-byte, including the displayed trailing space in the `(2,3)` witness.
